text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp starts today!
The Umamusume hop on the bus and
head for the Tracen Academy special facility!
During that time waiting for the bus.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: And, Falco. This is where it really counts!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"The sand quality on dirt tracks differs between the JRA and regional tracks.
What's more, regional tracks vary quite a lot among themselves! ...Got that?!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yes, Master!
Falco's taking notes☆

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Yeah.
For a while now, Espoir City has been showing off trivia to the Umamusume next to her—trivia that I faintly remember telling her at some point...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...A-And next is...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's Master's Trainer! ☆
Good morning!!
choice_data_list: Yeah, good morning! ...So, what's with this situation?
Yeah, good morning! ...So what's going on here?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh... Falco wouldn't stop bugging me
to teach her about dirt tracks.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I've got free time, I'm giving 'em special guidance.
...That's what a strong Umamusume is supposed to do, ain't it?

If I recall correctly, Smart Falcon ran in the Satsuki Sho
back in April, aiming for the turf Triple Crown.

Though the result wasn't stellar,
the Satsuki Sho is a Triple Crown GⅠ.
Just qualifying to run in it is proof of one's caliber.

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer
text_block_list.text:
...Why is Espoir City acting so high and mighty?
Though Smart Falcon seems to be playing along
without arguing back...

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text: "...I do not know. Is it the arrogance born of youth...?"

The two of them drew curious glances from those around them.
However, they themselves seemed entirely absorbed
in their own matters...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: So... this is the ultimate training menu, so keep it a secret from everyone else, okay?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"...It's plain and tough, but racewalking is pretty good.
Uhm... it trains your balance, too?
...Or so it seems?"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I see, I see... Mfuuu...!

...It seems Espoir City had written down
what I taught her previously in her notebook.
choice_data_list: (This is turning out to be good review.)
(This is turning out to be good review.)

text_block_list.name: Espo's Father
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer, what kind of education
do you think Espoir needs?

text_block_list.name: Espo's Father
text_block_list.text:
"For an Umamusume... for that girl.
What do you think the role of an educator is?"

"It is still difficult to say with certainty what
'education she needs.' However..."
"Perhaps this time spent teaching her might be the very 'education' Espoir City needs."
choice_data_list: ...I hear the "Strongest Umamusume" is also great at coaching.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...! I thought so!
The 'Strongest Umamusume' would totally do something badass like that!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Ah... And you, Trainer!
Out back. Now!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm bored on this bus.
Got any of that 'strongest Umamusume' stuff...?"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Like, the kind of move that'd shut down any Front Runner.
And the one next to me... is Falco.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: All right, Falco! Set your phone alarm for one minute from now, and flip the screen down!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"It's an alarm chicken race.
Whoever stops it closest to the 1-minute mark wins!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
If it rings, you lose, right?
...Ugh, fightâ

The duo in the front row are engrossed in a game to train their sense of timing.
Listening to their cheerful voices, I open my notebook.

"I want to make Espoir City stronger, and turn
her into an Umamusume who can truly acknowledge
her own strength."
—Jotting down that wish, summer training camp began.
